name: PA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+19 district lean with strong Democratic fundamentals
Incumbent Brendan Boyle running with $5.6M cash on hand
Republican challenger Jessica Arriaga has raised essentially nothing
model.rationale: Boyle holds a heavily Democratic Philadelphia-area seat with a large cash advantage and no meaningful outside opposition, while Arriaga has no visible fundraising or polling support. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy incumbent win.
model.watch: Any surprise polling showing a competitive race or major outside spending against Boyle would warrant a relook.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Brendan Boyle is seeking another term in a Philadelphia-area district that leans about 19 points Democratic, and the fundamentals suggest an even wider underlying margin. He has raised $2.45 million this cycle and holds $5.6 million on hand, with no outside groups opposing him.

Republican challenger Jessica Arriaga has no reported fundraising and no polling presence, and prediction markets give Boyle roughly a 94 percent chance of winning. With no expert ratings or general-election polls available, the forecast rests on the district's strong Democratic lean, Boyle's incumbency and financial dominance, all pointing to a comfortable incumbent victory.
